confirmedSourceFindings.rule: MDC-026/MDC-033: result provenance must identify the submitted assumptions, not the current draft
confirmedSourceFindings.detail: The page consumes publication.result but never publication.published.inputs. Every field change updates the visible draft while the published response, generated time, metrics and mitigation assumptions remain from the previous submission; editing alone produces neither a draft-versus-result marker nor an input snapshot.
confirmedSourceFindings.mechanism: useRetainedMutation.ts:64-68 clones submitted variables and :80-86 publishes that clone with the response, but ChargingSiteTwinPage.tsx:63,120-238,257-320 renders only result and live form values.
confirmedSourceFindings.sourceDerivedRepro: Reason about one synthetic successful scenario with charger_power_w=11500, then its field onChange setting 90000 without invoking submit. setForm changes the visible field/hint; publication.result remains the prior response and no render path consumes its saved inputs or marks the mismatch. This sequence was NOT executed.
confirmedSourceFindings.historicalDisposition: Reconfirmed unresolved audit-page-031 submitted-input finding; not a new regression, Phase5 redo or re-migration.
confirmedSourceFindings.fix: Assign one narrow page fix to expose or compare the existing published input snapshot and label unsubmitted draft changes without dropping retained outputs, changing raw SI or firing another request.

confirmedSourceFindings.rule: MDC-044/MDC-045: preserve saved date locale and timezone
confirmedSourceFindings.detail: Observation windows/times and result generation timestamps use the bare library formatter with no preference options; the same defect is present in AnalysisBrief.
confirmedSourceFindings.mechanism: EvidencePanel.tsx:6,62,90-92 and AnalysisBrief.tsx:10,71-72,118 call formatDateTime(value). dateFormat.ts:37-49 supplies timezone/locale only from optional opts, and :54-62 passes that to Date.toLocaleString. With opts absent it uses the browser defaults. Existing useDateFormat.ts:76-100 instead resolves saved settings locale/timezone.
confirmedSourceFindings.sourceDerivedRepro: Assume a browser default locale/timezone differs from saved settings.locale and saved tz_display_default=user/timezone_user. Render a synthetic valid generated_at or observation timestamp. These callsites pass no settings-derived opts and do not subscribe to useDateFormat, so saved changes cannot govern their date output. No settings change, date render or browser interaction was executed.
confirmedSourceFindings.fix: Assign the existing two domain adapters to reuse useDateFormat and its current timezone semantics; retain raw timestamps, unknown placeholders and complete observation-window information. Do not add a competing date formatter.
confirmedSourceFindings.owner: shared domain adapters: EvidencePanel and AnalysisBrief

confirmedSourceFindings.detail: The quality badge directly renders quality.status: sufficient, limited or insufficient. The adjacent AnalysisBrief already translates those same finite enum meanings.
confirmedSourceFindings.mechanism: EvidencePanel.tsx:57 places the enum directly in Badge children. AnalysisBrief.tsx:45-52 uses advancedIntelligence.brief.quality.sufficient/limited/insufficient, all confirmed present in canonical English by command 2.
confirmedSourceFindings.sourceDerivedRepro: Assume translated UI with a supported quality.status=limited. The brief chooses t(advancedIntelligence.brief.quality.limited); the evidence badge emits literal limited regardless of translator state. No locale switch or rendered capture was performed.
confirmedSourceFindings.historicalDisposition: Reconfirmed unresolved audit-page-031 raw-quality-label finding; not a newly introduced regression.

confirmedSourceFindings.rule: MDC-044/MDC-045: display evidence counts with saved numeric formatting
confirmedSourceFindings.detail: Evidence counts are interpolated as raw numbers in both evidence adapters, unlike their quality sample totals, which use the existing saved-number formatting bridge.
confirmedSourceFindings.mechanism: EvidencePanel.tsx:89 and AnalysisBrief.tsx:154 pass count:item.sample_count. Canonical sampleLine/evidenceSamples contain plain {{count}}, with no numeric formatter directive; i18n/index.ts:136 only configures escapeValue=false. The available fmtInt is already used at EvidencePanel.tsx:59 and AnalysisBrief.tsx:139.
confirmedSourceFindings.sourceDerivedRepro: For a synthetic evidence count 1234 and a saved locale requiring grouped/localized digits, the evidence interpolation receives unformatted 1234 while the quality sample display receives fmtInt(1234). The caller has no formatting step or settings-aware numeric interpolation directive. This is a source-derived mismatch; no i18next instance, app render or fresh test was run.
confirmedSourceFindings.fix: Retain numeric count for plural selection where required, and interpolate a separately fmtInt-formatted display value using the existing localization/formatting owners. Keep count null distinct from zero; do not change API data.
confirmedSourceFindings.owner: shared domain adapters; any changed canonical interpolation key requires a separate catalog owner
